# Distribution status

The mHandPro SDK binary is **not included in this repository or any release package**. This file keeps
the external artifact identity and packaging boundary visible so it cannot be added accidentally.

Real-glove users supply a legally obtained copy outside the repository and configure its absolute path
through `MHANDPRO_SDK_LIB`. The current Aero Hand PR contains no vendor binary, so vendor license and
redistribution review is outside this source-only change. A future change that adds or packages the
binary must perform that review again and preserve the vendor's license text and attribution terms.
